channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal to ban AI-generated music from December 9, removing millions of tracks: Tidal will stop accepting fully AI-generated music on December 9 and delete a large catalogue of existing AI tracks, reportedly around 27 to 29 million. It will still allow songs made with AI assistance.
Java4Shell: Oracle and OpenJDK ship fixes for a HotSpot JVM Base64 flaw: On November 17, Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes for CVE-2026-114938, a memory corruption bug in the HotSpot JVM's Base64 decoder, reported by Calif and dubbed Java4Shell. JetBrains is urging users to update its IDEs and related tools.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after near-24-hour Outlook outage: An Exchange Online and Outlook outage this month took email down for millions of customers for nearly a day. Reuters reports Microsoft responded by declaring an unusual internal "Code Red" after a bug on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers triggered it.
